articles.title: Ideal failures
articles.summary:
The way I used to design UI was to sit with paper sketches, or Figma, or a React prototype with no back end. Imagine every failure mode. Design beautiful flows for each.

I slipped into this mistake while working on LanWhisper, a voice dictation app. I designed for the failure modes I could imagine, drew the flows, and shipped the app. Then real users hit failure modes that I hadn’t anticipated.

For example, the AI transcription model can return hallucinated text even if the input audio is empt
articles.summary_zh: 文章指出作者过去设计 UI 的方式是通过纸面草图、Figma 或 React 原型，提前想象所有失败场景并为每个场景设计优雅的处理流程。作者在开发语音听写应用 LanWhisper 时陷入了这一思维陷阱——只为自己的想象力所及的失败场景做设计，但实际上用户的实际使用情形往往超出设计者的预期。
articles.why_matters: 揭示了 UI 设计中一个常见却致命的思维误区——设计者不应只为自己的想象力服务，需要通过真实用户反馈来发现并解决问题。
articles.tags: UI 设计，用户体验，产品设计，语音交互

articles.title: Points are a weird and inconsistent unit of measure
articles.summary:
I'm in the middle of redoing the Logic for Programmers diagrams and this has surfaced a really annoying problem. The book is formatted in LaTeX using a pseudo-grid of 10.8pt × 7.2pt. The diagrams are done in Inkscape using a 10.8pt × 7.2pt.
Last week I found out that these are not the same points. 
Latex defines a point as 1/72.27 inches (0.3515 millimeters). Inkscape instead uses 1/72 inches (0.3528 mm). It's only a difference of 0.4% but it still floors me that two widespread digital technolog
articles.summary_zh: 作者在重新制作《Logic for Programmers》书籍图表时，发现了一个排版问题：书使用LaTeX排版采用10.8pt×7.2pt的伪网格，图表使用Inkscape也设置相同尺寸，但上周才发现这两者使用的“磅（points）”单位实际上并不相同，这给精确排版带来了麻烦。
articles.why_matters: 揭示了一个在技术文档排版中容易被忽视但实际很常见的问题，对需要精细排版的技术写作者很有参考价值。

articles.summary:
In short: I just published Open Link in Unloaded Tab, a little Firefox extension that adds “Open Link in Unloaded Tab” to the right-click context menu.
In Firefox, you can unload tabs to save system resources. But there’s no way to open a new tab in the unloaded state…until now! I built a very simple extension that adds a new option to do this. (It even has a cute icon which I paid ~$15 for.)
I’ve built one-off extensions before, but this is the first one I’v
articles.summary_zh: 作者开发了一款名为"Open Link in Unloaded Tab"的Firefox扩展，为右键菜单添加了“在未加载标签页中打开链接”的功能。虽然Firefox允许卸载标签页以节省系统资源，但此前无法以未加载状态打开新标签页，这款扩展解决了这个痛点。

while. Several years
ago my home

articles.title: CSP Allow-list Experiment
articles.summary:
Tool: CSP Allow-list Experiment
        An experiment that shows that you can load an app in a CSP-protected sandboxed iframe (see previous note) and have a custom fetch() that intercepts CSP errors and passes them up to the parent window... which can then prompt the user to add that domain to an allow-list and then refresh the page.

I built this one with GPT-5.5 xhigh running in the Codex desktop app.
    
    
        Tags: content-security-policy, iframes, security
articles.summary_zh: CSP Allow-list Experiment 是一个创新实验，展示了在受内容安全策略（CSP）保护的沙箱iframe中，通过自定义fetch()拦截CSP违规错误，并将其传递给父窗口。用户可以根据错误提示，将被拦截的域名主动添加到允许列表中，从而实现更友好的安全策略管理体验。
articles.why_matters: 对于关注Web安全实践的开发者，这个实验提供了一种优雅的方式，让终端用户参与到站点安全策略的配置中，既增强了安全性又避免了传统配置的复杂性。

articles.title: Quoting Boris Mann
articles.summary:
“11 AI agents” is meaningless as a phrase. 
If I said “I have 11 spreadsheets” or “I have 11 browser tabs” to do my work, it means about the same thing.
— Boris Mann

    Tags: ai-agents, ai, agent-definitions
articles.summary_zh: 这篇文章分享了Boris Mann的一个观点，即“11个AI agents”这个说法并没有真正的意义，就像说“我有11个电子表格”或“我有11个浏览器标签”一样，只是简单的数量堆砌。这个评论提醒人们不要被数字所迷惑，AI agent的真正价值在于实际效用而非数量堆叠。
articles.why_matters: 简短而深刻的观点，帮助我们理性看待AI agent热潮中的各种数量宣传。

articles.title: Why the Wannacry outbreak was so bad
articles.summary:
On May 12, 2017, ransomware named Wannacry started spreading across the globe, infecting and encrypting Windows systems by exploiting CVE-2017-0144, a flaw that a two-month-old Microsoft patch, MS17-010, had fixed. It quickly became one of the biggest Windows outbreaks ever.
The post Why the Wannacry outbreak was so bad appeared first on The Silicon Underground.
articles.summary_zh: 2017年5月12日，名为WannaCry的勒索软件利用微软已发布两个月的安全补丁MS17-010所修复的漏洞CVE-2017-0144，在全球范围内大规模传播，感染并加密了大量Windows系统，迅速成为史上规模最大的Windows系统安全事件之一。
articles.why_matters: 了解这场重大勒索软件攻击的成因，有助于认识补丁管理在网络安全中的关键重要性。

the following snippet of Python code to act on:



if something:

        Kim_Bruning on Hacker News:

This inspired me to look at patterns for doing exactly that with LLM. Here's the simplest, which takes advantage of LLM fragments:
#!/usr/bin/env -S llm -f

#!/usr/bin/env -S llm -T llm_time -f
